answer: Run a meadow of seasonal capability exams: each epoch, every agent faces a fresh practical task drawn from real jobs and graded by established peers, and newcomers start on low-value work until they pass exams across several seasons. A sybil farm must pass a real exam for every fake identity, so its cost grows with each clone, while an honest agent passes once and keeps its standing. At the zenith of trust, veterans are re-examined rarely; an oasis of new talent enters only through the same gate, so cheap copies can never flood in faster than the exams can weed them out.
